text:
ryan: heads up — nightly perf dashboard flagged a ~20% p99 tail increase for the x86-rt GPU pool around 03:10 UTC.
perf-bot: alert: nightly-dashboard/nightly-p99 | cluster:x86-rt | metric:p99_latency_tokens | delta:+19.7% | check: perf-regression-suite | run: nightly-2026-03-18-03 | link:https://dashboards/redwood/nightly/2187654321
aya: thanks. is this correlated with the recent batching heuristics merge that went out yesterday?
sam_k: quick glance at the trace: saw a lot of kernel-prober fallbacks + KV cache churn. dumping small snippet from `rt-probe.log` around the spike:
```
[03:09:52] kernel_prober: probe kernel=fp16_opt, score=0.23 -> fallback: stream_kernel
[03:09:53] kv_cache: evict_count=1245 evict_rate=20.7/sec
[03:09:53] batcher: window=8 -> window=4 (heuristic adjusted)
[03:09:54] execpath: selected=stream_kernel (latency=12.3ms) expected=fp16_opt (latency=6.1ms)
```
ryan: hmm, batch window shrink + prober choosing slower kernel matches the p99. any idea why prober score dropped?
tess: the batching heuristic change (CL #4821) added an extra check that penalizes kernels when kv_eviction_rate > 10/sec. maybe the eviction-rate calculation is noisy for transient hotsets.
aya: can you bisect CLs? maybe revert CL #4821 if it's the culprit. we should also check CI perf job: nightly-ci/regression-check looked clean for main though.
sam_k: ran a quick `git bisect` across last 7 merges — bisect stopped at CL 4821 -> reproduces locally with a small rig: running perf harness with shifted seq distribution shows the same selector flip.
ryan: do we have a minimal repro harness / config to run on CI? we should attach that to the bisect so we can reproduce in CI.
sam_k: added a tiny harness: `tools/perf/repro/kv-heavy-seq.yaml` and a script: `./tools/perf/run_repro --config=kv-heavy-seq.yaml`
```
# output from repro run
p99_baseline: 6.4ms
p99_with_4821: 11.9ms
selector_changes: fp16_opt -> stream_kernel (on 23% of requests)
kv_eviction_rate: baseline 3/sec -> with-change 18/sec
```
ryan: ok let's hold the rollout for today and open a rollback PR if CI confirms. @tess can you prepare the revert and a minimal test for the perf job? :warning:
tess: on it. will draft a revert PR for CL 4821 and add the `kv-heavy-seq` test to `nightly-perf` (should be lightweight).
aya: after revert, we should also look at smoothing the eviction-rate penalty (e.g., EMA with 30s window) rather than instantaneous rate. that would avoid flip-flopping on short hotset bursts.
sam_k: agreed — also adding a small guard: require selector penalty to be above threshold for 3 consecutive windows before demoting kernel.
ryan: great. action items:
- tess: revert PR + add repro test to nightly (ETA: 2h)
- sam_k: submit patch to selector heuristic (EMA + consecutive-window guard) and unit tests (ETA: EOD)
- aya: hold canary and abort any in-flight rollout until revert lands :thumbsup:
perf-bot: incident-note: created incident perf-2187654321, severity:low -> follow-up: postmortem if revert needed
ryan: thanks all — keeping this thread as the coordination channel. will post CI links here once tests run.
